title: Halren On Bulwarks
response: A Bulwark is not brave because he stands still. He is brave because he chooses the line before fear chooses it for him.

title: Halren On Road Duty
response: The road will not ask whether you feel ready. Good. Readiness is overrated. Discipline is more portable.

title: Halren On The Oath
response: An oath is not poetry. It is a rule you obey when panic starts making suggestions.
sourceNote: Source-safe oath and Bulwark training framing.

title: Halren On Training
response: Guard Stance first. Shield Oath second. Fancy heroics never once impressed a healer.
sourceNote: Runtime tutorial support for Bulwark basics.

title: Renn On Little Dawn
response: I heard the shrine bell last night. It rang inward. I know that sounds impossible. I would very much like it to be impossible.

title: Renn On Fear
response: I am afraid in a very organized way. I made a list. The list did not help, but it made the fear look official.
sourceNote: Local party social texture constrained to Renn's starter role.

title: Renn On The Party
response: If you hold the front, I can call the shrine marks. I cannot promise elegance. I can promise I will not run unless everyone is running.
sourceNote: Local party role support for First Road.

title: Renn On The Pilgrimage
response: They call it a training route because that sounds kinder than admitting the road is training us back.
sourceNote: Source-safe Pilgrimage of the First Bell framing.

title: Ila On Road Danger
response: The road is Concord-safe on paper. Paper is thin. Keep your shield between the fields and anyone with soft shoes.

title: Ila On Wolves
response: Wolves do not usually care about shrine bells. That is why I care about the claw marks.

title: Ila On Concord Paperwork
response: Paperwork is what makes courage legible to people who were not there. Annoying, yes. Useful, also yes.

title: Olla On The Bell
response: A bell that rings outward warns the living. A bell that rings inward asks the dead who they remember.

flagResponses.response: Now you know the difference. The road heard you answer, and the bell did not have to ask twice.

sourceNote: Source-safe Little Dawn inward bell motif.

title: Olla On The Cryptlet
response: The Cryptlet is not deep. It does not need to be. Some lessons only require one locked door and one honest mistake.

title: Olla On The Trial
response: Stand between the traveler and the dark. That is the whole trial. The rooms only change the shape of the dark.
sourceNote: Source-safe Trial Under Little Dawn framing.

title: Olla On Rewards
response: The road pays in proof before it pays in gear. Bring back a clean report, and let the cache worry about what it owes.
